nodes.description: uint256 ACTIVATION_TIME = 1621249900, activation timestamp used by the isActivated modifier
uint256 internal entryFee_ = 10, percentage fee charged on token purchases
uint256 internal transferFee_ = 1, percentage fee charged on peer transfers
uint256 internal exitFee_ = 10, percentage fee charged on sells
uint256 internal referralFee_ = 20, share of the fee paid as referral bonus
uint256 internal maintenanceFee_ = 10, share of the fee paid to maintenance address
address internal maintenanceAddress, recipient of maintenance fees
mapping(address => uint256) internal tokenBalanceLedger_, internal token balances
mapping(address => uint256) internal referralBalance_, accrued referral payouts
mapping(address => int256) internal payoutsTo_, already accounted dividend payouts
mapping(address => uint256) internal invested_, total amount invested per holder
uint256 internal tokenSupply_, total outstanding internal token supply
uint256 internal profitPerShare_, accumulated dividends per token scaled by magnitude
uint256 public stakingRequirement = 1000e18, minimum balance required to earn referral bonuses
uint256 public totalHolder, counter of holders
uint256 public totalDonation, running total of donated MDX
TOKEN erc20, external ERC20 token contract used for deposits and withdrawals
msg.sender, untrusted caller address used as the holder identity throughout the contract
block.timestamp (now), untrusted time value used for activation checks and event emission
external call erc20.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), _amount) inside checkAndTransferMDX
external call erc20.transfer(_customerAddress, _dividends) inside withdraw
raw (non-SafeMath) multiplication by magnitude / profitPerShare_ share accounting that can overflow
require(now >= ACTIVATION_TIME) in the isActivated modifier, a block.timestamp dependency
raw division by tokenSupply_ in share accounting (divide-by-zero / precision risk)
constructor that sets maintenanceAddress and the erc20 token address
private helper that pulls MDX from the caller via erc20.transferFrom
public distribute(uint256 _amount) that accepts donations and increases profitPerShare_
public buy(uint256 _amount, address _referredBy) entry point for purchasing tokens
public buyFor(uint256 _amount, address _customerAddress, address _referredBy) buys tokens for another address
payable fallback function that always reverts
public reinvest() guarded by onlyDivis, compounds dividends and referral balance into tokens
external exit() that sells the whole balance then withdraws
public withdraw() guarded by onlyDivis, pays out dividends and referral balance via erc20.transfer
public sell(uint256 _amountOfTokens) guarded by onlyTokenHolders, burns tokens and credits payouts
external transfer(address _toAddress, uint256 _amountOfTokens) between holders with a fee
internal purchaseTokens(address _referredBy, address _customerAddress, uint256 _incomingMDX) core minting logic guarded by isActivated
public myDividends(bool _includeReferralBonus) view helper for the caller's dividends
public dividendsOf(address _customerAddress) view that computes owed dividends from profitPerShare_ and payoutsTo_
public getInvested() view returning invested_[msg.sender]
public balanceOf(address _customerAddress) view returning the internal token balance
parameter _amount of distribute(uint256)
parameter _amount of buy(uint256,address)
parameter _referredBy of buy(uint256,address)
parameter _amountOfTokens of sell(uint256)
parameter _toAddress of transfer(address,uint256)
parameter _amountOfTokens of transfer(address,uint256)
parameter _incomingMDX of purchaseTokens(address,address,uint256)
parameter _referredBy of purchaseTokens(address,address,uint256)
parameter _customerAddress of purchaseTokens(address,address,uint256)
local variable _dividends computed inside withdraw
local variable _customerAddress assigned from msg.sender inside reinvest
local variable _tokens returned by purchaseTokens inside reinvest
local variable _undividedDividends computed inside sell
local variable _taxedMDX computed inside sell
local int256 variable _updatedPayouts computed inside sell
local variable _tokenFee computed inside transfer
local variable _taxedTokens computed inside transfer
